Work with secure remote access, bastion models, and least-privilege access.

Operating Systems & Hosting Stack

 Manage production hosting/server environments on: Linux: Ubuntu, Debian, AlmaLinux, Rocky Linux, CentOS (legacy), Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Windows Server: 2016 / 2019 / 2022 (IIS/AD is a plus) Maintain and optimize web server stacks and hosting infrastructure: Nginx, Apache, LiteSpeed / OpenLiteSpeed Reverse proxy setups, SSL/TLS, caching, log analysis, performance tuning Bonus exposure: PHP-FPM, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis, HAProxy, Keepalived

 Monitoring, Reliability & Incident Response

 Monitor infrastructure performance and proactively resolve incidents to minimize downtime. Build alerting and observability (metrics/logs/traces) and improve real-time monitoring workflows. Documentation & Collaboration

 Maintain detailed infrastructure documentation: configurations, diagrams, policies, and runbooks. Collaborate with DevOps, Support, Product, and Leadership teams to ensure reliability, availability, and scalability. Recommend architecture improvements and propose new product/feature ideas for Ultahost’s cloud offerings.

 5+ years of experience in cloud VPS management, hosting infrastructure, data center operations, or similar roles. Strong, hands-on experience with: Proxmox clusters + KVM/QEMU Ceph storage (deployment, troubleshooting, tuning, scaling) Juniper networking (routing/switching/troubleshooting) Solid expertise across: Virtualization & HA concepts (cluster HA, migration, replication, failover) Networking protocols and technologies (BGP, OSPF, VLAN, VRRP, LACP, etc.) Performance tuning and root-cause analysis under pressure Security fundamentals (firewalls, VPNs, hardening, patch management) Monitoring and incident response best practices Strong English written & verbal communication skills. Comfortable with fast-paced environments, autonomy, and shift/on-call requirements. Bachelor’s degree in a related field (or equivalent experience).

Bonus Points (Nice to Have)

 Experience with OpenStack, VMware, Hyper-V, oVirt/RHV, Xen, LXD/LXC. Automation experience with Ansible / Terraform / Python / Bash / CI-CD. Kubernetes knowledge (deploying/operating clusters for customers). Hosting billing/provisioning integration experience (WHMCS or custom systems).
